aggregate_criterion_inherited_from_v01.g_pres_subset_a_a_relative: Arm M within-Recon mean 4-dim Manhattan distance from the per-evaluator reference vector <= Arm C within-Recon mean 4-dim Manhattan distance from the same reference vector + 1.5
aggregate_criterion_inherited_from_v01.g_pres_subset_a_b_absolute: Arm M within-Recon mean 4-dim Manhattan distance from the per-evaluator reference vector <= 2.5 absolute (per proposal v5.1 §6 + v0.1 §11.2)
aggregate_criterion_inherited_from_v01.scope_note_pi_freeze_correction_1_C_minu: The +1.5 tolerance applies ONLY to G_pres_subset_a_a. Arm-C validity envelope (C20) is not enlarged by this tolerance. C20 uses its own envelope bound per inputs/baseline-statistics.json + hashing/c20-derivation.py.

non_collapse_attestation: The 4 dimensions in subset-(a) are evaluated via the aggregate 4-dim Manhattan criterion. They are NOT individually mapped to the C12 axes of subset-(b). Some display names may overlap (subset-(b) has 'selection_significance' as C12-3, 'lifetime_framing' as C12-5, 'factual_discipline' as C12-7, 'end_of_report_synthesis' as C12-4); these are independently scored under their respective subset's criteria and reported as distinct gates. The two subsets are evaluated as disjoint (different ID namespaces: BIB-4D-1..4 vs C12-1..8).
